purpose: The Merchant Portal API allows merchants to view settlements, manage users, and request reports through the Merchant web app.

components.name: Portal Gateway
components.evidence: single ingress for the web app

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: identity provider for merchant users; the gateway uses it to check callers

components.name: portal-db
components.evidence: PostgreSQL: settlements, merchant users and report jobs

flows.evidence: external API calls are authenticated with OAuth2/OIDC bearer tokens issued by our identity provider
portal-db (PostgreSQL): settlements, merchant users and report jobs
portal-db and the message brokers sit in private subnets and are not publicly reachable

flows.data: authentication failures, privilege changes and access to sensitive data
